device.name: Antelope Discrete 4 Synergy Core
device.notes: vid, pid and bcdDevice all read from the unit's own Windows PnP instance id on a machine with it attached and enumerating: USB\VID_23E5&PID_A2BE carries FriendlyName "Discrete 4 Synergy Core", and HID\VID_23E5&PID_A2BE&REV_0401&MI_03 is the vendor-defined HID interface. The vid is no longer an assumption carried over from Orion. Serial deliberately not recorded.

transport.notes: report_size 320 is not assumed from Orion: this model's format defines the 0x83 meter report as a 16-byte header plus afx_meters of ubyte * 304, exactly 320. Interface 3 is from the PnP instance id (MI_03). Endpoints carried over from the family and NOT separately confirmed on this unit.
transport.evidence: Antelope's own machine-readable report format for this model, report_format_1.4.39 under the discrete4_hybrid slug. Read 2026-08-31 from a machine with the unit attached; the identical file, same SHA-256, is present on a second machine.

command.notes: SET_PARAM shape (magic/opcode/param_id_offset/channel_offset/value_offset) not yet captured for this device. Do not assume it matches Orion Studio III's 0x70/0x13/16/17/18 -- confirm from a fresh capture first, per README.md step 4 (check the outgoing URB_INTERRUPT out frame, not just the state-report diff).

state_report.notes: Base offsets are NOT filled in, deliberately. parse_state() reads gain_base_offset, status_base_offset and status_bits without consulting status, so putting numbers there would make `status` report a gain and a phantom state that no one has checked against a real frame. The numbers below are good enough to be worth having and not good enough to act on. They are listed in unresolved_state_offsets. WHAT IS KNOWN: Antelope's own report format declares the 0x73 layout for this model field by field with bit widths - 49 fields totalling 1824 bits, 228 bytes of payload, a 244-byte frame. Three models walk to that same 1824 from 49, 66 and 69 declared fields. WHAT AGREES: the field list and struct shapes were checked against a live device through Antelope's server - every declared name appeared and nothing else did, preamp_gains came back with the declared length and sign, and the preamp status byte carried exactly five sub-fields: type (4 bits), phantom, hpf, phase_inv, zero_cross. That bit order matches what this repository already found by observation elsewhere - phantom 0x10 shift 4, phase 0x40 shift 6 - and adds hpf at bit 5 and zero_cross at bit 7. WHAT IS UNPROVEN: position. The server hands over decoded fields, not raw bytes, so the ordering of the walk has not been seen on the wire. Parse one raw 0x73 frame with these numbers, check it against a known gain, and they can move up.
state_report.evidence: Antelope report_format for this model, plus a live field-name and value check through the vendor's server on port 2021, 2026-09-01. Provenance: a JSON file Antelope's installer places on the disk of anyone who installs their software, at .AntelopeAudio/<slug>/panels/report_format_<version>. World-readable, not encrypted, not obfuscated, no confidentiality marking, no credentials; reading it is what the vendor's own panel does at startup. No binary decompiled, no protection measure circumvented, no firmware touched, and the file itself is not redistributed - only facts derived from it.

channels.notes: The 0x73 preamps block is a struct of count 4, one status byte per preamp, and preamp_gains beside it is byte * 4. The two agree here, unlike on the Pro where the gain array is byte * 7 for four preamps.
channels.evidence: Antelope's own machine-readable report format for this model, report_format_1.4.39 under the discrete4_hybrid slug. Read 2026-08-31 from a machine with the unit attached; the identical file, same SHA-256, is present on a second machine.

buses.notes: Output bus ids (monitor A/B, headphone, etc.) not yet captured for this device -- do not assume Orion Studio III's 0/1/2/5 mapping applies.

unresolved_state_offsets: state_report base offsets, derived from Antelope's declared 0x73 layout but NOT yet verified against a raw frame: gain_base_offset 40 (byte * 4), status_base_offset 44 (one byte per preamp, count 4), no volumes_and_mutes block on this model at all.
status_bits from the same source: type mask 0x0f shift 0, phantom 0x10 shift 4, hpf 0x20 shift 5, phase_inv 0x40 shift 6, zero_cross 0x80 shift 7.
